title: Recorded bench readings
description: Read the registered quantity and unit for one evidence edition. The horizontal axis shows the source register’s own elapsed milliseconds. Each point retains its source row and locator.

list.name: edition
list.label: Recording
list.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z, stop: 2026-01-02T00:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "evidence_sample" and r._field == "elapsed_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["serial", "edition", "series_id"])
  |> first()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.serial + " · " + strings.replaceAll(v: r.series_id, t: "-", u: " ") + " · " + strings.substring(v: strings.split(v: r.edition, t: "~")[1], start: 0, end: 8) + "|" + r.edition}))
  |> group()
  |> sort()
list.definition:

  |> group(columns: ["serial", "edition", "series_id"])

panels.title: Readings over time
panels.description: Each marker is a registered reading. Repeated clock marks retain separate source rows. Read the quantity and unit in the register below.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "evidence_sample" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "source_row"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({"Elapsed ms":r.elapsed_ms, row:r.source_row, reading:r.value, label:r.quantity + " (" + r.unit + ")"}))
  |> pivot(rowKey:["Elapsed ms","row"], columnKey:["label"], valueColumn:"reading")
  |> sort(columns:["Elapsed ms","row"])
  |> drop(columns:["row"])

panels.title: Readings in the selection
panels.description: Source interval, observed value and locator within the original worksheet. Elapsed milliseconds come from each recorded reading.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synthetic")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "evidence_sample" and r.edition =~ /^${edition:regex}$/)
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "source_row"])
  |> keep(columns: ["elapsed_ms", "source_row", "value", "unit", "quantity", "locator", "source", "sample_id", "source_id", "serial", "revision", "method", "series_id", "edition"])
